component.name: Fluke 289 Live Studio
component.summary: Read, record and compare Fluke 289 measurements

description.p: Interface language: English. This release provides an English user interface, messages, reports and documentation.
View live measurements, record CSV or SQLite sessions and explore interactive plots. Organize recordings in a measurement library and compare them with PDF and CSV reports.
This independent application supports experimental meter memory downloads and does not modify meter memory. It is not affiliated with Fluke.
